response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.rate AS excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A scan with zero duration has an undefined size-per-minute ratio and is ignored by the average.
